No dosimeter; no measured dose rate.
frases.Elegí una zona de caminata y una ruta ap: Choose a walking zone and an approved route with simulation data.
frases.Vista simulada desde el relieve HiRISE (: Simulated view from HiRISE terrain (not real video)

frases.Medidas independientes, errores de 1 sig: Independent measurements, 1 sigma errors. Uses the GPS-free geolocation fusion; do not enter the same reading twice.
frases.Orientación del teléfono solo para mirar: Phone orientation for looking around only
frases.Radiación y DONKI: sin parte cargado; no: Radiation and DONKI: no report loaded; absence of risk is not assumed.
frases.No se pudo localizar. Revisá los datos o: Could not locate. Check the data or try again.
frases.Corrección recibida. El radio 95 % es mo: Correction received. The 95% radius is modeled and requires calibration.
frases.La corrección no es válida para esta zon: The correction is invalid for this zone.
frases.Falló el Worker de localización. Podés v: The localization Worker failed. You can try again.
frases.Localizando en el Worker; caminata en pa: Locating in the Worker; walk paused.
frases.No hay foto en esta posición. Cargá foto: No photo at this position. Upload photos with metadata or approach the scenario stop.
Could not read the photo or its metadata. CAHVOR and attitude are required.
frases.Fotos cargadas. Agregá sus metadatos y t: Photos loaded. Add metadata and press Photo.
frases.No hay camino de regreso disponible dent: No return path is available within the limits.
frases.Foto real NASA/JPL-Caltech, Curiosity Na: Real NASA/JPL-Caltech photo, Curiosity Navcam, sol
No real photo at this position.
frases.La navegación se detuvo por datos inváli: Navigation stopped due to invalid data. Export the log.
frases.V para hablar; Espacio pausa; S estado;: V talk; Space pause; S status; O oxygen; P position; N waypoint; R return; A abort; F photo; M hazard; H help; + speed; arrows look around; Esc end.
frases.Reconocimiento de voz no disponible sin: Voice recognition requires browser support and may need a connection. Use buttons and keyboard. Speech synthesis requires an installed local voice.
frases.Contexto lejano no disponible: horizonte: Distant context unavailable: horizon limited to the local DTM.
frases.ABORTAR: no alcanza el margen de regreso: ABORT: insufficient return margin. Return to the shelter using the calculated path.
frases.ABORTAR: regreso desconocido o fuera del: ABORT: unknown return or emergency limit exceeded.
frases.ABORTAR: regreso ordenado por la tripula: ABORT: return ordered by the crew.
frases.ABORTAR: la posición estimada queda en t: ABORT: estimated position is on forbidden or unknown terrain.
frases.Terminá la salida: queda poco margen de: End the excursion: low return margin.
frases.Te saliste del corredor. Pausá y localiz: You left the corridor. Pause and locate before continuing.
frases.El error de posición supera el radio de: Position error exceeds the decision radius. Correct with a photo or measurements.
frases.Precaución: suelo blando probable, model: Caution: probable soft ground, modeled using THEMIS.
frases.Espacio pausa; S estado; O oxígeno; P po: Space pause; S status; O oxygen; P position; N waypoint; R return; A abort; F photo; M hazard; H help; + speed; arrows to look around; Esc ends.
frases.En un traje real estos controles podrían: In a real suit these controls could be operated with finger gestures (a sensor glove) or forearm buttons.
frases.Fotos cargadas. Tocá Foto: los datos de: Photos loaded. Tap Photo: camera data is looked up at NASA by the file name.
frases.Subí fotos Navcam de Curiosity con su no: Upload Curiosity Navcam photos with their original names: camera data (CAHVOR and attitude) is fetched from NASA automatically. Offline, also load their JSON.
frases.Orto real · verde: zona segura modelada: Real ortho · green: modeled safe area · amber: 95% error
frases.Posición incierta junto a terreno prohib: Uncertain position near prohibited terrain: pause and correct your location.
frases.NASA no respondió o faltan metadatos CAH: NASA did not respond or CAHVOR and attitude metadata are missing. Offline, load the photo JSON and try again.
frases.El navegador bloqueó la pestaña nueva: p: The browser blocked the new tab: allow pop-ups for this site.
frases.No hay una ruta aprobada para navegar: c: There is no approved route to navigate: calculate it in this tab and tap “Start navigation”.
A route with a calculated return is required.
No terrain is available at the start.
frases.La fusión no devolvió una posición válid: Fusion did not return a valid position.
That measurement has already been recorded.

Aim the reticle at the marked ridge.
